description: This file defines a static class 'Slug' with an extension method 'GenerateSlug' that converts input strings into URL-friendly slugs. It uses regular expressions to clean and format the input string, trimming, replacing invalid characters, and condensing whitespace.

classes.name: Slug
classes.description: A static class providing utility methods for generating URL slugs from strings.

methods.name: GenerateSlug
methods.description: Converts an input string into a URL-friendly slug, handling null input, converting to lowercase, removing invalid characters, collapsing spaces, trimming length, and replacing spaces with hyphens.

methods.name: InvalidCharsRegex
methods.description: Returns a regex that matches characters invalid in URL slugs.

methods.name: MultipleSpacesRegex
methods.description: Returns a regex that matches multiple whitespace characters.

methods.name: TrimRegex
methods.description: Returns a regex that matches whitespace characters for replacing with hyphen.
